title: 按先进先出假设推算库存库龄
context: 仓储部门希望识别期末长期库存；本库无实物批次拣货记录，按FIFO数量推算，非实际批次审计。
requirements: 将期初库存视作2023-01-01批次，收货与退货视作入库批次；累计销售出库消耗最早批次；期末剩余批次中2025-07-04及以前为≥180日；按仓库商品输出陈旧件数、陈旧金额（期末标准成本）和陈旧比例；仅有陈旧件数。
commonError: 使用最后一次入库日期代表所有库存库龄会低估老批次。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,'2023-01-01' d,0 seq,quantity q FROM inventory_opening WHERE quantity>0 UNION ALL SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,movement_date,movement_id,quantity_delta FROM stock_movements WHERE quantity_delta>0), b AS (SELECT *,SUM(q) OVER(PARTITION BY warehouse_id,product_id ORDER BY d,seq ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) cum FROM a), s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), z AS (SELECT b.*,CASE WHEN b.cum<=COALESCE(s.sold,0) THEN 0 WHEN b.cum-b.q>=COALESCE(s.sold,0) THEN b.q ELSE b.cum-COALESCE(s.sold,0) END remain FROM b LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=b.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=b.product_id), g AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(CASE WHEN d<='2025-07-04' THEN remain ELSE 0 END) aged,SUM(remain) total FROM z GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT g.warehouse_id,g.product_id,g.aged aged_units,g.aged*i.unit_cost_cents aged_value_cents,ROUND(100.0*g.aged/NULLIF(g.total,0),2) aged_pct FROM g JOIN inventory_snapshots i ON i.warehouse_id=g.warehouse_id AND i.product_id=g.product_id AND i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' WHERE g.aged>0 ORDER BY aged_value_cents DESC,g.warehouse_id,g.product_id
